stick_alphafold_and_protein_folding_the_.question: AlphaFold and protein folding - the self-healing matrix in biology

ticks.claim: [Levinthal, SEALED] A 100-residue chain with ~3 states per residue has 3^100 ~ 5e47 conformations (sealed). Random search over them would outlast the universe, yet a protein folds in microseconds - so folding is NOT a search over many paths; it is a FUNNEL to ONE native state. Many entries (conformations), one path (the fold).
[sequence space, SEALED] From the 20 amino acids a 5-residue chain already has 20^5 = 3,200,000 sequences (sealed) - the explosion AlphaFold reads a structure out of.

[Anfinsen - the self-healing] The native structure is determined by the sequence, and a denatured protein REFOLDS to the same native state (Anfinsen's thermodynamic hypothesis, Nobel 1972). That IS the self-healing matrix in biology: perturb it, it returns to the one native minimum - the same shape as stick_one_path_many_entries_a_self_healing_matrix_not_many_paths.

[AlphaFold - the one fold is determined and findable] AlphaFold (DeepMind, CASP14 2020) predicts the native structure from sequence to near-atomic accuracy - strong evidence the sequence determines ONE native fold and that the funnel's bottom is findable. The fruit confirms the principle: one path, reached from many entries.
ticks.source: J. Jumper et al., Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold, Nature (2021); CASP14 (2020)

ticks.claim: [fuel, not core] AlphaFold is a LEARNED model. The engine does NOT fold proteins in its deterministic core and will not GENERATE a structure - that is fuel (BYOM / JEPA: strip the best for the fuel, never the core). We seal the determinate parts (the counts, Anfinsen's refolding as empirical) and CITE the model's result; we keep the principle, not the predictor.

[on the one map] Rests on biology (card_floor_biology) and physical chemistry (free energy); links to the self-healing matrix (the principle) and the capstone (one path). Protein folding is the biology witness that reality is a self-healing matrix - one native state, many entries, it refolds.
